name: Encore City: Neon K-pop City (art bible v2, a delta from 'Island Encore' v1)
vibe:
My Island becomes a tiny harbour city at golden hour that turns into a neon stage after dark. The reference is a sleek designer-toy diorama, not a nursery toy. It has crisp bevelled architecture, smoked glass, concrete, teak boardwalks, LED strips and screens. All of it sits on an island with a real irregular coastline, faceted cliffs at the back, a gentle hill rising behind the home and a city skyline glittering across the bay.

GOLDEN HOUR is the default look: a peach-to-violet sky, a low warm key light with long shadows, the first signs and windows already lit. SHOWTIME is full night: an indigo sky, a magenta city glow on the horizon, three sweeping spotlights, LED edges chasing along the boardwalks and the crew dancing on the concert stage.

The K-pop energy comes only from original staging: streetwear, light sticks, LED screens, stage trusses, dance breaks and member colours. Nothing is copied.

COLOUR RULE v2 (replaces v1's 70/20/10 pastel rule):
- 60% deep and mid neutrals (sky, sea, concrete, graphite, deep greens)
- 28% mid-saturated colour (pets, walls, props, the child's member colour)
- 12% neon, on emissive lines, rings, signs and screens only. Neon stays under 8% of the frame at golden hour.

The cuteness dial moves from 'baby' to 'cool older sibling': smaller confident eyes, longer legs, less squash, cleaner shapes, and witty copy instead of 'Yay!'.

ANTI-RIGID RULE: every home shape, every building and every repeatable decor has 2–3 deterministic per-copy variants (hash of uid or profile). The coastline is seeded per child. No two islands, homes or trees look stamped out, and nothing is ever random at purchase.

lightingDefault:
DEFAULT = GOLDEN HOUR. It replaces DAY as the preset the island opens in and the one every encore returns to; the v1 pastel DAY preset leaves the toggle. The 'slwShowtime' localStorage key keeps its meaning: '1' gives Showtime, anything else gives golden hour. Renderer unchanged: NeutralToneMapping, SRGBColorSpace.

Golden hour values:
- Exposure 1.05.
- HemisphereLight: sky #9C8CFF, ground #3A2550, intensity 1.35. No ambient light.
- Key 'sun': #FFB48A at 2.2, position (-10, 6.5, 8) aimed at (0, 0, 0). That is about 30° elevation from front-left, so faces toward the camera are warm-lit and long shadows fall back-right.
- Calibration: lit Turf reads #4FA36A ±6% L on screen. Tune only the key intensity.
- Shadows (MID/HIGH, static map, autoUpdate false): ortho camera widened to left/right -13..13 and top/bottom -9..9 for the longer shadows, near 1, far 45, bias -0.0005, normalBias 0.03. 1024² on MID, 2048² on HIGH. LOW uses blob shadows only.
- Rim: #FFB0D9 at strength 0.35, mixed 25% with the member colour, exponent 3.0 (was 2.5).
- Sky dome: #2B1E5C → #6A3D8F → #FF9A7A. A sun-disc halo sprite (r 3 u, #FFD6A0 at 0.6, additive) sits on the horizon behind the skyline at yaw -30°.
- Fog: #7E4E8E, near 28, far 72. The skyline uses fog:false with a manual 55% haze tint toward #7E4E8E.
- Sea: shallow #3FB8D0, deep #1E3F86, foam #FFD9E8, wave lines #FFC7B0 at 0.35. The 40 glints stay, tinted #FFD6A0.
- Already on at golden hour: neon sleeves at 0.25, halos ×1.2 at opacity 0.6, windows at 0.6, skyline windows 30% lit, stars 0.25 (zenith only), LED screens 0.7. Spot cones are off.

SHOWTIME = NIGHT STAGE (the toggle, plus the 8 s encore after a purchase, an unlock or a goal):
- Exposure 1.1.
- Hemisphere: sky #5A4BD1, ground #1A1030, intensity 0.75.
- Key 'moon': #A9B8FF at 0.8 from (-7, 14, 9). It is higher than the sun so the grid stays readable.
- Rim: #FF5FD2 at strength 0.6, mixed 50% with the member colour.
- Sky: #0B0A1F → #1E1450 → #C2338F, the city-glow band.
- Fog: #1E1450, near 22, far 58.
- Sea: shallow #1F4FA8, deep #0B1440, foam #B9A8FF. Add additive Magenta/Cyan reflection streaks under each lit sign (instanced quads, max 24).
- Neon at 1.0, halos ×1.6 at 0.9, windows 1.0, skyline windows 70% lit, stars on (250, or 120 on LOW), LED screens 1.0.
- 3 spot cones: Neon Magenta, Neon Cyan, Electric Violet, sweeping ±25° at 0.12 Hz, 120° apart. They mount on the LED ring buoys and the stage truss when bld_stage is placed, otherwise on the pole behind the home.

TRANSITION: 1.6 s inOutSine (reduced motion: a 0.25 s crossfade). Signs and windows switch on in a 'city wakes up' ripple outward from the home, 40 ms per cell. Each light fades in over 0.3 s, never pops. Under reduced motion they all switch together in the crossfade.

PHOTOCARD / SHOP STUDIO preset:
- hemi #B9B0FF / #2A2240 at 1.4
- key #FFE2C8 at 2.2 from (-5, 8, 9)
- rim = member colour at 0.45
- transparent clear colour over the dark CSS card well

FLASH SAFETY:
- Full-contrast LED chases ≤ 1.5 Hz.
- Beat-synced pulses ≤ 1.97 Hz (118 BPM) with at most ±35% brightness change.
- Skyline windows toggle ≤ 0.2 Hz each.
- No full-screen luminance change > 20% within 0.5 s, and no strobe.
materialsAndOutlines:
TOON: keep the single shared MeshToon program (customProgramCacheKey 'encore-toon'). The ramp moves from 4 soft bands [110,165,215,255] to 4 crisper, deeper bands [64,128,200,255]. Darker core shadows give a graphic, night-time read instead of a pastel nursery read. Rim patch: same code, new values (exponent 2.5 → 3.0 for a thinner, glossier rim; strengths and colours as in lightingDefault).

BEVELS AND PROPORTIONS:
- Architecture (home shapes, buildings, attractions, paths, benches, bollards): slab default radius 0.05 × the smallest side (was 0.18), segments 2. That gives crisp designer edges.
- Organic and character pieces (pets, avatar, plants, rocks, bean bags) keep 0.18.
- Drop the '1.2× chunkier than real' rule for architecture (use 1.0×); props use 1.1×.
- Trees become low-poly: Icosahedron detail 0, flatShading, 3–5 clusters. No more puff canopies.

OUTLINES:
- Architecture loses the ink hull entirely: houses, buildings, attractions, decor. Crisp bevels plus rim do the job and save about 8–12 draw calls.
- Characters (pets, accessories, avatar) keep a hull at 0.009 u (was 0.012) in Midnight Ink #14101F, MID/HIGH only.
- The only hull on architecture is edit-mode selection: 0.02 u in Star Gold #FFD23F, pulsing 0.02↔0.03 at 1.5 Hz.

MATCAPS (128², canvas-drawn, one shared matcap program):
- GOLD and CHROME: kept.
- SMOKED GLASS: radial, a #8FB7FF spec dot at uv (0.32, 0.28) → #2A3B5C at 35% → #1B2438 at 70% → #0E1626 at the edge. It is OPAQUE: the v1 transparent PEARL 'glass' is retired for windows (fill-rate). Lit windows swap to Window Warm through the existing 'state' material.
- GUNMETAL: #E6E9F2 → #7C8194 → #5A5F72 → #2A2D3A, for railings, truss, posts, frames.
- FOIL: conic #FF7AD9 → #7AD7FF → #9DFFCF → #FFE27A. It replaces PEARL for the holo bits (shades lens at night, bubbles).

NEON: same core-plus-additive-sleeve system, with a sharper core:
- core r 0.015 (was 0.02), sleeve r 0.05
- sleeve opacity 0.25 at golden hour, 0.45 at Showtime
- Neon is always a line, ring, sign or pictogram, never a painted surface.

LED SCREENS: MeshBasic with a canvas atlas (256×64, or 256×128 for the stage), animated only by UV offset and never redrawn per frame.
- Content: original abstract graphics only (EQ bars, waves, ✦ sparks, member-colour gradients, the child's emoji). The only word allowed is ENCORE.
- Share the program the avatar's emoji face already compiles (basic + map) so the total stays ≤ 12 shader programs.

SURFACE RICHNESS WITHOUT TEXTURES: concrete and paving get vertex-colour noise of ±3% L on a 0.25 u grid. Teak alternates Teak/Teak Light per plank. No extra decal layers (3 overlapping transparents max).

EMISSIVE DECALS: reuse the existing ground decal for uplight pools under trees, bollards and signs (r 0.5; opacity 0.25 at golden hour, 0.4 at night, in the light's colour). LED edge strips on paths and boardwalks reuse the v1 path under-glow quad.

WATER: same shader with new colours. Wave lines are 0.6× as wide. The foam band 0.10 + 0.05·sin follows the new noisy coastline through the re-baked shore field.

PER-OBJECT RULE:
- Each object uses ≤ 3 tones of one family plus ≤ 1 neon accent.
- Buildings use 1 neutral body + 1 accent (member colour or a fixed accent) + Smoked Glass + neon/LED: ≤ 4 materials and ≤ 4 merged meshes.
characterRestyle:
PETS (pet_puppy, pet_kitten, pet_bunny, pet_dragon). PETCOL colours stay LOCKED; only shape, eyes and motion change. Edits are in models-characters.js assemblePet / jointsOf / socketsOf.

Proportions:
- Head puff r 0.17 → 0.155 (head is now about 40% of height, was 45%).
- Body bean(0.17, 0.18) scaled [0.9, 0.78, 0.8] → bean(0.16, 0.20) scaled [0.85, 0.80, 0.85].
- Legs puff 0.048 × [1, 1.55, 1] → 0.042 × [1, 1.9, 1]: longer and more athletic.
- BODY_Y 0.22 → 0.235. Head, sockets and anchors move +0.015 y.
- Muzzle scale [1.25, 0.8, 0.85] → [1.15, 0.72, 0.95], a slightly longer snout.

Eyes (the biggest de-babying lever):
- Ink puff 0.032 × [0.9, 1.15, 0.55] → 0.024 × [1.15, 0.8, 0.5], at x ±0.072 (was ±0.068) and y 0.402.
- Rolled 8° so the outer corner sits higher.
- Add an upper-lid ribbon (r 0.006, Tk.dark) over each eye.
- Glint disc 0.011 → 0.006, moved upper-outer.
- Resting openness 1 → 0.88 for a relaxed, confident look. Blinks unchanged (0.16 s every 3–6 s).

Face:
- Blush discs are removed at rest. They show only in cheer/happy, at a 0.3 mix (was 0.6, always on).
- Mouth: the symmetric smile becomes a small side-smirk (ribbon points [-0.02, 0.316, 0.35] → [0.002, 0.31, 0.357] → [0.024, 0.322, 0.35]).

Species:
- Puppy: ears [0.42, 1.3, 0.85] → [0.36, 1.25, 0.8], tucked 10° back.
- Kitten: ear cones h 0.11 → 0.125, slightly sharper.
- Bunny: the right ear rests folded at 35° (asymmetry gives it attitude).
- Dragon: horns cone(0.022, 0.065) → cone(0.02, 0.095), swept back 40°. Spines 3 → 5 smaller rounded cones (0.025 × 0.07). Each wing gains 3 rib ribbons (r 0.006) for a sleek scalloped edge. Still puffs sparkles, never fire.

Motion:
- Idle squash 0.015 → 0.007.
- Universal tap squish 1 → 0.92 → 1.06 → 1 becomes 1 → 0.96 → 1.03 → 1.
- Walk speed 0.9 → 1.0 u/s.
- 'roll over' and 'scratch' idles are replaced by 'lean' (hips 6°, head tilt 8°, 2 s), 'nod to the beat' (headPitch ±6° on beats, only while music plays) and 'look-back' (head yaw 60° and back).

Dance break (generic moves only, 8 counts at 118 BPM):
- 1–2: groove bounce (0.02 u on half-beats) plus a shoulder pop
- 3–4: step-touch
- 5–6: signature moves: puppy paw-point combo, kitten slide-step, bunny hop-turn 180°, dragon wing-flare
- 7: snap to camera
- 8: freeze pose with one paw raised and head tilted 12°

Outline: 0.009 u in Midnight Ink.

EXISTING 6 ACCESSORIES: restyled, but names and descriptions stay true.
- Party hat: matte with 2 stripes.
- Crown: thinner band (h 0.03) with 5 sharper points.
- Bow: same spots, 15% smaller.
- Scarf: slimmer torus (r 0.022).
- Shades: one wraparound shield lens (tube segment R 0.15, 150°, h 0.032) in Midnight Ink, switching to FOIL at night.
- Cape: Gunmetal clasp.

- acc_cap 'Snapback' (hat, 160 ⭐): worn backwards (yaw 180°). Crown is a half-puff r 0.085 squashed to y 0.6 in Graphite. Flat brim slab 0.10 × 0.012 × 0.075 with a Neon Magenta underside (lit only at night) and a Concrete Light top button. Bunny wears it between the ears.
- acc_beanie 'Beanie' (hat, 120 ⭐): tube r 0.088 h 0.07 with 10 vertex-colour ribs (Concrete Light / Graphite), a folded cuff torus and a tiny Laser Lime tag. Bunny ears poke through.
- acc_headphones 'Studio headphones' (neck, 180 ⭐): worn round the neck DJ-style. Half-torus band R 0.10 r 0.012 in Graphite, 2 Gunmetal cups (tube r 0.042 h 0.03) with Neon Cyan rings that glow at night and pulse ±20% on the beat. Rides the neck bone, no bone switching.
- acc_hoodie 'Hoodie' (back, 260 ⭐): a body shell (the body bean ×1.06, top 70%) in Graphite, a hood draped behind the head (half-puff r 0.09) and 2 Neon Magenta drawstrings (r 0.006, l 0.06).
- acc_visor 'LED visor' (face, 220 ⭐): a wraparound Smoked Glass band (R 0.16, 140°, h 0.03) with a Neon Cyan LED line. At night one dot scrolls across it at 1 Hz; it is static under reduced motion.
- acc_bomber 'Bomber jacket' (back, 240 ⭐): the hoodie shell in #4E5A3E olive with a #FF8A3D collar lining and ribbed cuffs.

'YOU' AVATAR: idol-style chibi in streetwear. The face stays the child's own emoji on the face cap, never a realistic face. Height 0.95 → 1.0 u, ≤ 1,500 tris on MID and 1,050 on LOW.
- Head: the face-cap sphere R 0.244 → 0.205 (same emojiFace texture). It sits inside a HOOD shell: sphere r 0.225 keeping only back, top and sides (z < 0.12), in member colour −12% L. A hood-rim torus R 0.165 r 0.02 in member colour frames the emoji. Two Bone White drawstrings (r 0.006, l 0.09). A thin Gunmetal headset-mic ribbon (r 0.005) runs from the left side of the hood to the cheek and ends in a 0.012 puff: the 'on stage' tell.
- Torso: an oversized hoodie, bean(0.17, 0.20) in Graphite, with a member-colour chest band (y 0.36–0.40) and member cuffs. Sleeves are Graphite arm beans; hands are Bone White puffs r 0.03.
- Legs (new; v1 had only foot puffs): 2 beans r 0.06, len 0.10, in Asphalt (joggers).
- Sneakers: slab 0.10 × 0.055 × 0.15 (radius 0.02) in Bone White, with a 0.012 member-colour sole stripe and a Midnight Ink lace dot.
- Idle: weight shift (hips 5°, 2.4 s period); the glance every ~6 s is kept.
- Tap: one of 3 emotes, cycled by hash plus tap count: a finger-heart (neon line-heart sprite), a V-sign with head tilt, or a mic-point to camera.
- Showtime: holds the Spark Stick and twirls it 360° over 1.2 s every 8 s (off under reduced motion).

SPARK STICK: replaces the puffy 5-point Island Wand everywhere (avatar, crowd, loading spinner, Showtime icon). makeWand keeps its API. ≤ 260 tris.
- Handle: tube r 0.014 h 0.13 in Midnight Ink, with a member-colour grip band (h 0.02) and a Gunmetal collar ring.
- Head: a crisp 4-point ✦ prism (ExtrudeGeometry rOut 0.06, rIn 0.016, depth 0.022, bevel 0.004 × 1 seg) in member-colour neon. A white inner ✦ at 60% scale sits 0.002 proud for a frosted-acrylic read. Halo 0.35 u.
- It is 4-pointed so it never reads as the 5-point ⭐ reward. It must not resemble any real light stick.

CROWD: fan blobs become night silhouettes.
- Bodies in Crowd Shadow #2A2348, #33295A or #3D3166 (seeded). The 'crowd' detail has no face; the colour comes from their Spark Sticks (member colours plus Magenta/Cyan/Violet).
- 'Hero' fans get 2 tiny Bone White eye dots.
- Wave timing unchanged.
uiV2:
FONTS (Google Fonts, one link, display=swap; island and games only, learning screens keep their fonts):
- Unbounded 800 (display): screen titles, banners (GOAL!, ENCORE, NEW PERSONAL BEST), countdown digits and the PET COURSE banner texture. Letter-spacing -0.01em, never below 20 px, never body copy.
- Unbounded 600: sheet headings (h2), 20–24 px.
- Outfit 700/800: buttons, chips, prices and HUD. Outfit 600 for labels. Outfit 400/500 for body at 16 px, line-height 1.45.
- Any number that changes (points, timers, scores) uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.
- Tokens: --sle-display: 'Unbounded', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; --sle-ui and --sle-body: 'Outfit', same fallbacks.

COLOUR: one dark theme in both presets; Showtime only adds glow.
- Island page background #0E0B1A.
- Panels: rgba(22,18,40,0.72) with backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(1.3) plus the -webkit- prefix. On LOW, or where it isn't supported, solid #15112A. Border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12), inner highlight inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08), shadow 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), radius 16px (sheets: 20px top corners).
- Text #FFFFFF, secondary #B8B2D6, disabled #6E6890 on #221C3A.
- Primary CTA: linear-gradient(120deg, #E0157F, #7B4DFF), white Outfit 700 15px, letter-spacing 0.02em, glow 0 6px 20px rgba(224,21,127,0.35).
- Secondary: transparent, 1.5px #22E4FF border, #22E4FF text.
- Ghost: rgba(255,255,255,0.06) with a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.14) border.
- BUY stays green (#2ECC71 → #1FA463, text #04301A).
- Points pill: panel glass, ⭐, a #FFD23F tabular number and a 1px rgba(255,210,63,0.35) border. One 0.4 s shimmer when points change.
- Focus ring stays 3px #FFD23F with offset 2px.

SHAPES (replaces the puffy-sticker style):
- Buttons are flat: no 3px white sticker border, no 4px 'lip' shadow. Radius 12px, min 44×44, padding 10px 16px. Pressed = scale(0.97) and the glow halves.
- Chips and pills: 999px with a 1px edge. Cards: radius 14px.
- Icon buttons: 44px circles in ghost style. Camera controls ⟲ ⟳ ＋ － ⌂ become a vertical ghost stack.
- Celebrations: a centred glass card (max-width 420px) over a 40% #0E0B1A scrim, not a full-screen candy gradient.

SHOP (dark 'drop' cards, 3:4):
- Card #1A1530 with a 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.10) edge. Image well radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%, #3A2A6E, #15112A 70%), the item on a Gunmetal riser with a Neon Magenta ring.
- Name Outfit 700 15px white; description Outfit 400 13px #B8B2D6; price Outfit 800 16px #FFD23F.
- Shine goes by price only; the bands are unchanged:
  - shine 0: plain edge
  - shine 1: 1.5px foil edge (#FF7AD9 → #7AD7FF)
  - shine 2: animated foil border with an 8 s hue drift (was 6 s; slower reads classier)
  - shine 3: gold foil (#FFE89A → #F0C02F → #C9921A) with 2 glints every 4 s (was 3)
- Tilt-shine ±6°, desktop only, never on touch or under reduced motion.
- NEW chip: a #FF2E9A outline pill with white text, not a filled bubblegum pill.
- New shop tab 'City' for the buildings. The home sheet gets a 'Shape' row first, then Walls, Roof, Door, Extras.

ICONS:
- Replace the UI-chrome emoji (🛍️ 🐾 🎮 ✏️ 🏠 🎯 📦 🌙✨ ☀️) with an in-house inline-SVG line set: 24-unit grid, 2px stroke, round caps and joins, currentColor, shown at 20–22px.
- Showtime = crescent moon plus ✦. Golden hour = half-sun on a horizon line.
- Emoji remain only as the child's avatar and as ⭐ for points.

MOTION:

dontDo: Don't copy or evoke real idols, groups, agencies, songs, music shows, venues, logos, fandom names or fandom colour schemes. No Hangul and no 'K-pop' or 'idol' wording in the UI. Never let one two-colour pair dominate a scene; always mix Magenta, Cyan, Violet and the member colour.

Don't use any real light-stick silhouette: no sphere-on-a-stick, hammer, cube, heart, bird, crown, hexagon or ring-with-logo heads. The 4-point ✦ Spark Stick is the only light stick, and it must never read as the 5-point ⭐ reward.
Don't use recognisable choreography. Dance clips are built only from generic moves: groove bounce, step-touch, point, spin, freeze pose.
Don't flash faster than 2 Hz. Full-contrast LED chases ≤ 1.5 Hz, beat pulses limited to ±35% brightness, no strobe, no full-screen flash. Reduced motion freezes chases to a steady glow.

Don't go edgy or teen-adult: no skulls, flames, weapons, graffiti words, ripped or revealing outfits, make-up, smoking, nightclubs, bars or alcohol (the café serves boba). Streetwear stays modest: hoodies, joggers, sneakers, caps.

Don't make it dark or scary. The darkest value is Night Zenith #0B0A1F; the island must read clearly on the LOW tier with no shadows and no outlines, at both golden hour and Showtime. No under-lighting on faces.
Don't paint neon onto big surfaces (walls, ground, sky). Neon is lines, rings, signs and screens: ≤ 8% of the frame at golden hour, ≤ 15% at Showtime.

Don't edit existing CATALOG ids, prices, names, descriptions, LOCKED colours, ECONOMY, REGIONS, canPlace or GAME_RULES. Don't add fields (such as rotation) to placed records. All variety comes from deterministic hash(uid)/hash(profileKey) variants and new additive ids.
Don't introduce chance: no random variants at purchase, no gacha, loot boxes, timers or 'limited time'. Shine stays price-only, and buildings and acts never award or spend points.
Don't jitter the position or yaw of houses, buildings, attractions or paths. Only organic decor gets yaw/scale jitter, and small decor only the fixed −20°/0°/+20° set.
Don't make the backdrop skyline, harbour pier or ferry pickable, or look like buildable land; it sits well outside the 16×10 grid.

Don't use transparent glass, PointLights or SpotLights, real-time shadow updates or new post-processing. Stay within ≤ 12 shader programs and ≤ 70/100/150 island draw calls (LOW/MID/HIGH), plus the tri budgets.
Don't put words in textures except ENCORE, PET COURSE and GOAL-type banners, and never brand-like logos. Screens show abstract graphics, icons and the child's emoji.
Don't download models, textures, HDRIs or sounds, and don't load fonts beyond Unbounded and Outfit for the island and games.
Don't lose the cartoon safety net: tumbles stay goofy, pets never get sad, there are no injuries, the dragon never breathes fire and the volcano never erupts.
Don't over-bounce. No overshoot easing on UI sheets or celebration cards, no jelly squash on buildings. Keep the reduced 0.96/1.03 tap squish and the drop-in landing only.
Don't write babyish copy (yay, boing, cosy, tiny, poorly), and don't put more than one emoji in a message.
